name: stage3d_recovery_observability_v2
purpose: Test whether legal evidence observed before a Geometry call predicts its incremental value in policy-induced recovery states.

observation_boundary.cost_accounting: ORB evidence is measured as part of the cheap Localize action; no uncharged segmentation or change network is used.

feature_ladder.f0: 24D structured retrieval, cheap-candidate dispersion, verifier, temporal-state and budget evidence
feature_ladder.f1: 34D F0 + actual cheap correspondence spatial coverage/entropy/concentration
feature_ladder.missing_optional_features: represented as zeros plus an availability bit; only recovery states with a cheap localizer receipt expose these optional fields

training.source: natural Oracle data plus C3.6-policy-induced live-cost recovery trajectories
training.targeting: oversample Geometry-positive, near-boundary and high-regret recovery states only in training; retain natural-prior calibration data
training.controller: component utility model; P(correct accept), P(false accept), cost, recovery time and memory pollution are composed under the frozen utility contract

evaluation.selection: all feature levels use the identical collection and controller protocol; comparison uses a previously unseen temporal split
